response.sql: SELECT store_id, COUNT(*) AS customer_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_customers, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / AVG(COUNT(*) * 1.0) OVER () AS multiple_of_avg_store_count FROM customer GROUP BY store_id ORDER BY store_id

assumptions.assumption: All customers in the customer table are counted, regardless of the active flag, grouped by customer.store_id.
The average store count is the mean of per-store customer counts across stores that have at least one customer (the stores appearing in customer).
